statement: The kernel maintains controller serial-derived input identity and a battery power supply within each steam_device registration; its sensor node uses the same registered controller identity. The SDL context handles battery reports for its currently attached joystick and returns no fixed player index. Neither source here proves a persistent Puck pairing-slot identity across detach.

applicability.revision: pinned Linux v7.3-rc1 and SDL 6defbc0 consumer source; retail hardware unmeasured
applicability.scope: Steam Controller 2026 Puck receiver consumer behavior; no physical or virtual host test
